items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; Rams get Puka Nacua back expected.
items.why: Sidelined all week with hamstring; sources expect no go. Nacua practiced/expected after hip/groin.
items.implication: Smith sit; Nacua WR1 boost vs PHI without Smith.
items.opportunity: Wicks/others elevated targets in PHI; Nacua full role return.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; will miss minimum four games (eligible Week 9 after bye).
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirms IR.
items.implication: Stash if IR spot; drop in shallow leagues. Opens Saints backfield.
items.opportunity: Lead role/volume for Kamara and Miller on early downs/pass work.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (back) and Zay Flowers (hamstring) both upgraded to full participants Thursday after limited/prior issues.
items.why: Practice upgrades clear path; minor issues only.
items.implication: Both locked-in QB1/WR1 starts vs TEN; no designation expected.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; Dowdle out again. Top-10 play.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share; favorable matchup and short week usage history ignored for volume.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry and volume spike; soft secondary.
items.opportunity: High target share/redzone with Penix back.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% target share/34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 pts in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization.
items.why: Historical underperformance with Penix; low utilization this year.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Notable high placement post strong usage.
items.why: ETR staff ROS Top-150 factors injuries/roles/schedule; Walker near top after debut production.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst underperformers relative to opportunity.
items.why: Data on targets/aDOT/redzone; underperformed opportunity chart.
items.implication: Sit/flex risk even with Penix; TE streamer territory.
items.opportunity: Low; look elsewhere for TE volume.
items.conflict: Some may still start on name; usage disagrees.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 4 rankings live (updates Fri/Sun); snaps & pace notes (DAL@HOU up-tempo; LAC@SEA slow).
items.why: ETR specialist rankings post Week 3 film/news.
items.implication: Use for start/sit; pace impacts volume.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42%; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
LOVE Garrett Wilson (Mitchell out, 36% prior share), Josh Downs (31% targets/43% RZ, WAS soft), George Kittle (climbing share, Evans DTD, DEN soft vs TE).
HATE Emeka Egbuka (new QB Jalon Daniels, low RZ, low total), Xavier Worthy (shrinking share vs Rice rise, low aDOT), Justin Herbert (pressure, SEA elite pass D, low total).
Seahawks designate RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.implication: SEA backfield committee imminent; monitor Price/Wilson shares.
items.opportunity: Potential split; Price role shrink risk.

items.text: Prefers Jonathan Taylor side in Flowers + Montgomery for JT trade; wants the '1' in 2-for-1 when close.
items.why: ETR trade calculator/values favor JT as the premium piece.
items.implication: Acquire JT if possible; high ROS value.
